[LNUL.8.2] **Join equality on two absent values.** Cross-pattern **join**
equality `a.x == b.x` is **non-matching when both are `null`** (SQL-style).
Forced by bounded-RT: matching null-keys would make *N* null-keyed facts
mutually join → O(N²) tokens → `DS_ERR_TOKEN_BUDGET`. Nullability must not
become a token-budget DoS.
